```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(rjags)

metaldata <- read.csv("S:\\R code markdown\\E2.csv")

Y <- metaldata[,2]
X <- metaldata[ , !(names(metaldata) %in% "CRP")]
Xs <- scale(X)

miss  <- is.na(Y+rowSums(Xs))
Y <- Y[!miss]
Xs <- Xs[!miss,]

n <- length(Y)

```


```{r}
for (i in 1:ncol(X)) {
  plot(X[,i],Y)
}
```
## Full model


```{r}
datare <- list(Y=Y,X=Xs,n=n,p=ncol(Xs))
model_string <- textConnection("model{

   # Likelihood
   for(i in 1:n){
     Y[i] ~ dnorm(alpha + inprod(X[i,],beta[]),tau1)
   }

   # Priors
   for(j in 1:p){beta[j] ~  dnorm(0, 0.0001)}
   alpha ~ dnorm(0,0.01)
   tau1 ~ dgamma(0.01,0.01)
   
 }")
modelre <- jags.model(model_string,data = datare, n.chains=2,quiet=TRUE)
update(modelre, 10000, progress.bar="none")
params <- c( "alpha","beta")
samples <- coda.samples(modelre, variable.names=params, n.iter=10000, progress.bar="none")
```


# Trace

```{r}
par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
plot(samples)
```

## Gel 1

```{r }
sumre <-summary(samples)
gelman.diag(samples)
```

# PPC for Model 1
```{r}
datare <- list(Y=Y,X=Xs,n=n,p=ncol(Xs))
model_string <- textConnection("model{

   # Likelihood
   for(i in 1:n){
     Y[i] ~ dnorm(alpha + inprod(X[i,],beta[]),tau1)
   }

   # Priors
   for(j in 1:p){beta[j] ~  dnorm(0, 0.0001)}
   alpha ~ dnorm(0,0.01)
   tau1 ~ dgamma(0.01,0.01)
   
  # PPC
   for(i in 1:n){
     Y2[i] ~ dnorm(alpha + inprod(X[i,],beta[]),tau1)
   }
   D[1] <- max(Y2[])
   D[2] <- min(Y2[])
   D[3] <- max(Y2[]) - min(Y2[])
   D[4] <- mean(Y2[])
   D[5] <- sd(Y2[])
 }")
modelre <- jags.model(model_string,data = datare, n.chains=2,quiet=TRUE)
update(modelre, 10000, progress.bar="none")
params <- c("D", "alpha","beta")
samplesppc <- coda.samples(modelre, variable.names=params, n.iter=10000, progress.bar="none")
```


```{r}
D1 <- samplesppc[[1]]
D0 <- c(max(Y), min(Y), max(Y) - min(Y), mean(Y), sd(Y))
pval <- rep(0,5)
names(pval) <- c("max Y", "min Y", "range Y", "mean Y", "sd Y")

for (i in 1:5) {
  pval[i] <- mean(D1[,i] > D0[i])
}
pval
```

# SSVS
```{r}

beta <- NULL
for(l in 1:2){
    beta <- rbind(beta,samples[[l]])
}
names <-c("Int","SEQN", "cadium", "lead", "mercury", "PFDeA", "PFHxS", "PFNA", "nPFOA", "sbPFOA", 
                    "age", "incomeration", "CRT")
colnames(beta) <- names

 for(j in 1:13){
   hist(beta[,j],xlab=expression(beta[j]),ylab="Posterior density",
         breaks=100,main=names[j])
}
```
# SSVS Table
```{r}
library(knitr)
  Inc_Prob <- apply(beta!=0,2,mean)
   Q        <- t(apply(beta,2,quantile,c(0.5,0.025,0.975)))
   out      <- cbind(Inc_Prob,Q)

   kable(round(out,2))

```

## Model with only significant parameters Includes lead, mercury, age, and incomeratio

```{r}
Xsmall <- cbind(Xs[,3], Xs[,4], Xs[,10], Xs[,11])
names(Xsmall) <- c("lead", "mercury", "age","incomeratio")
```

```{r}
datanore <- list(Y=Y,X=Xsmall,n=n,p=ncol(Xsmall))
model_string_no_re <- textConnection("model{

   # Likelihood
   for(i in 1:n){
     Y[i] ~ dnorm(alpha + inprod(X[i,],beta[]),tau1)
   }

   # Priors
   alpha ~ dnorm(0,0.01)
   for(j in 1:p){beta[j] ~  dnorm(0, 0.0001)}
   tau1 ~ dgamma(0.01,0.01)
 }")
modelnore <- jags.model(model_string_no_re,data = datanore, n.chains=2,quiet=TRUE)
update(modelre, 10000, progress.bar="none")
params <- c("alpha", "beta")
samples2 <- coda.samples(modelnore, variable.names=params, n.iter=10000, progress.bar="none")
```
#Trace

```{r}
par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
plot(samples2)
```

## DIC comparisons for model 1 and model 2
```{r}

DIC2 <- dic.samples(modelnore, n.iter=10000,progress.bar="none")
# 19004 
# 19465 
DIC1
DIC2
```


## Neg Exp model
```{r}
Xsexp <- cbind(Xs[,4], Xs[,5], Xs[,8])
```

```{r}
data_exp <- list(Y=Y,X=Xsexp,n=n,p=ncol(Xsexp))

params <- c("D","alpha", "beta")

# JAGS model
model_string_exp <- textConnection("model{

 # Likelihood
 for (i in 1:n) {    
   Y[i] ~ dnorm(mu[i], tau)
    mu[i] <- alpha * exp(inprod(X[i,],-beta[])) 

  }

  # Priors   
  alpha ~ dgamma(0.1, 0.1)
  for(j in 1:p){beta[j]  ~ dgamma(0.1, 0.1)}
  tau <- pow(sigma, -2)
  sigma ~ dunif(0, 10)
  
    # PPC
   for(i in 1:n){
     Y2[i] ~ dnorm(mu[i], tau)
     mu2[i] <- alpha * exp(inprod(X[i,],-beta[])) 
   }
   D[1] <- max(Y2[])
   D[2] <- min(Y2[])
   D[3] <- max(Y2[]) - min(Y2[])
   D[4] <- mean(Y2[])
   D[5] <- sd(Y2[])
 }")


modelexp <- jags.model(model_string_exp, data = data_exp,n.chains = 2,quiet=TRUE)
```


```{r}
update(modelexp, 10000) 
samplesexp <- coda.samples(modelexp, variable.names = params, n.iter = 10000)

```

```{r}
summary(samplesexp)
par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
plot(samplesexp)
```
